name: theme-selection
body: `theme` is optional and deck-wide only (never per slide); omitted = `default`. Available themes are exactly the directories under the deck's merged library's `themes/` (the external library at the configured `templates:` path when set, and the deck-root `templates/` directory; see layered-template-library); there are no built-in themes. A named (or defaulted) theme that the project does not define is an error listing the project's available themes with a closest-match suggestion. A theme may build on another theme in its own layer by importing its stylesheet — `@import url('theme:<name>/theme.css')` (theme-media-references) — so shared structure lives in one theme and selectable themes differ only in tokens; the referenced `<name>` must itself be a theme in the importing theme's own library layer, and an unknown one is a templates error naming the CSS file and line. Because every deck resolves a theme, a merged library that defines no theme (its `themes/` empty or absent) is load-valid but cannot host a deck; a library intended to host decks provides the deck's theme (the `default` theme is sufficient — see init-library). The theme mechanism remains a registry so themes are added by adding a directory, without template changes.
